name: logseq-geml
description: GEML as a text serialization for Logseq DB graphs: as readable as their Markdown export, as lossless as their EDN export. Converts `logseq export-edn` output to a tree of .geml documents and back.

scripts.test: node test/roundtrip.test.mjs && node test/sync.test.mjs && node test/cli-sync.test.mjs
